note.zh-TW: 教材五層利益的第 3 層，直譯自日本會計基準的経常利益。課程部分頁面把它和稅前淨利合寫，是因為故事沒有非常損益；網站一律分成兩列。
note.en: Level 3 of the five profit levels, a direct translation of the Japanese GAAP ordinary profit. Some course pages merge it with profit before tax because the story has no extraordinary items; the site always shows them as two lines.

definition.zh-TW: 損益表第 3 層的小計：營業利益加上營業外收入、減去營業外支出。名稱裡的「經常」是和非常損益相對而言；沒有非常損益時，它和稅前淨利同額，本課故事就是這樣。
definition.en: The level 3 subtotal of the income statement: operating profit plus non-operating income less non-operating expenses. ‘Ordinary’ is meant in contrast to extraordinary items; when there are none it equals profit before tax, as in the course story.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 與台灣現行報表都沒有這一層。IAS 1.87 禁止把任何收益或費損列為非常項目，所以不需要再區分經常與非經常的損益；IFRS 對照的版面不顯示這一列。
ifrsNote.en: Neither IFRS nor current Taiwanese statements have this subtotal. IAS 1.87 prohibits presenting any income or expense as extraordinary, so there is no need to separate ordinary from non-ordinary results; the IFRS comparison layout hides this line.
